summary: Lets another player wear one additional Enchantment; Attuned itself does not count towards their Enchantment limit.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: If Attuned is removed, the bearer chooses which (m) Enchantments to lose to meet the new Enchantment limit, if necessary.

restrictions.note: May not be used in conjunction with itself or any other similar abilities.

properties.note: Attuned does not count towards the bearer's Enchantment limit.
On removal, the bearer chooses which (m) Enchantments to lose.

clarifications.text: If Attuned is removed, the bearer chooses which Magical Enchantments to lose to meet their new Enchantment limit, if necessary.

open_questions: L1 'any other similar abilities' is not defined; Essence Graft (same wording) and Phoenix Tears (which excludes Attuned) are the likely candidates, but Evolution N1 says Evolution does work with Attuned.
